items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: I used to go up to the jukebox late at night and listen to that all the time, listen to that bass player, Ed Jones.

ctx.x: Yes. I used to go up to the jukebox late at night and listen to that all the time, listen to that bass player, Ed Jones. Remember Ed Jones?
